name: NCAA D-I Southeast Regional Cross Country Championships
headline: NCAA D-I Southeast Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: No. 2 NC State won the women’s race with 71 points as Hannah Gapes won in 18:42.2, with No. 9 South Carolina second (100) and No. 12 Clemson third (105). No. 9 Wake Forest won the men’s race with 72, and No. 18 Eastern Kentucky edged No. 15 Virginia Tech 104 to 105 for second. Louisville’s Elsingi Kipruto won the men’s race by 16.5 seconds in 28:20.3.
